say:3:1120743002:0.text: Quit... dancing around so much. Making me... dizzy.
say:3:1120743002:0.source_cn: 别……别在我眼前晃来晃去，头好晕。

say:4:1120743003:0.text: Just... leave me alone... need to rest. So tired of digging around the tunnels... just want some sunshine...
say:4:1120743003:0.source_cn: 你还是，别打扰我了……让我再休息一会儿……好不容易从开...

say:11:1120743005:0.text: I remember people in the camp saying milk, herbs, and a tiny amount of spider venom could be mixed to clean blood and boost energy.
say:11:1120743005:0.source_cn: 我记得营地里的人说，把牛奶、药草和极其微量的蜘蛛毒液按...

say:12:1120743006:0.text: They relied on that potion to lift their spirits while working everyone to death.
say:12:1120743006:0.source_cn: 他们靠那种药剂来提振精神，以监督苦工工作……

say:14:1120743008:0.text: C-Chak! That's the boss' prized recipe!
say:14:1120743008:0.source_cn: 奇奇奇奇奇克！那是老大最宝贝的配方！

say:15:1120743009:0.text: That's because it's very useful. I just hope it can help them.
say:15:1120743009:0.source_cn: 因为宝贝，所以有用。希望对部落里的人有帮助。

say:16:1120743010:0.text: Let's go gather spider venom, Rumon.
say:16:1120743010:0.source_cn: 我们去找蜘蛛毒液吧，卢玛。
